{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "请列出2026年9月12日当天注册的用户姓名、城市和注册时间，按注册时间升序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "查询register_date = '2026-09-12'的users表记录，返回user_name、city、register_date三列，ORDER BY register_date ASC，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中明确指定‘2026年9月12日当天’，但未说明该日期是绝对日历日（即register_date = '2026-09-12'），还是需匹配created_at的日期部分；根据schema_metadata，register_date为DATE类型且定义为‘注册日期’，故应以register_date为准；此处无歧义——但按协议要求，本题归类为time类ambiguous，唯一待冻结slot为时间粒度：必须确认是否严格使用register_date字段（而非created_at）及是否允许隐式范围（如'2026-09-12' vs '2026-09-12 00:00:00'）。业务合同与schema均明确register_date为注册日期主字段，因此冻结slot为‘register_date = 2026-09-12’。",
      "semantic_signature": "users.register_date_eq_20260912:user_name_city_register_date:order_by_register_date_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT user_name, city, register_date FROM users WHERE register_date = '2026-09-12' ORDER BY register_date ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计过去30天内（以2026年9月12日为基准）各城市的付费用户数，按城市升序排列。",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "统计在[2026-08-14, 2026-09-12]区间内产生过valid orders的users.city分组计数，返回city和COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)，ORDER BY city ASC。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-08-14",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘过去30天内’未明确是否包含首尾（即30个完整日历日还是29天+基准日）；依据business_contract中‘Last N days use DATE_SUB from the explicit reference date’，标准解释为DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 29 DAY)至'2026-09-12'（共30天），即起始日为2026-08-14。冻结slot为起始日期：2026-08-14。",
      "semantic_signature": "users.city_count_distinct_paying_users_last30d_from_20260912:city_count:order_by_city_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS count FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY u.city ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出最近一个月上架且仍在售的商品名称、品牌、上架日期和类别，按上架日期降序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选products表中launch_date在最近一个完整日历月（即2026-08-01至2026-08-31）且is_active=1的记录，返回product_name、brand、launch_date、category四列，ORDER BY launch_date DESC，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-08-01",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘最近一个月’在业务语境中可指‘上个月’（calendar month）或‘过去30天’；business_contract明确定义‘last month are complete calendar boundaries’，且参考日期为2026-09-12，故‘最近一个月’即2026年8月全月。冻结slot为时间范围起始日：2026-08-01。",
      "semantic_signature": "products.launch_in_aug2026_active:product_name_brand_launch_date_category:order_by_launch_date_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT product_name, brand, launch_date, category FROM products WHERE launch_date >= '2026-08-01' AND launch_date <= '2026-08-31' AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY launch_date DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计昨日（2026年9月11日）各支付方式的有效订单数量，按支付方式升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "统计orders表中order_date = '2026-09-11'且order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')的payment_method分组计数，返回payment_method和COUNT(*)，ORDER BY payment_method ASC。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-11",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘昨日’在问题中已通过上下文锚定为2026-09-11，但需确认是否严格等于order_date = '2026-09-11'（而非order_datetime日期部分）；business_contract规定‘Order time uses orders.order_date’，故以order_date为准。冻结slot为具体日期值：2026-09-11。",
      "semantic_signature": "orders.payment_method_count_valid_on_20260911:payment_method_count:order_by_payment_method_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE order_date = '2026-09-11' AND order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY payment_method ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出过去7天内（含2026年9月12日）有退款且退款状态为已批准的订单号、退款金额和退款日期，按退款日期升序、退款金额降序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选refunds表中refund_date ∈ ['2026-09-06', '2026-09-12']且refund_status='approved'的记录，关联orders获取order_no，返回order_no、refund_amount、refund_date三列，ORDER BY refund_date ASC, refund_amount DESC，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-06",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘过去7天内（含2026年9月12日）’存在边界歧义：是7个自然日（含当日）即2026-09-06至2026-09-12，还是从2026-09-12减6天得起始日？business_contract规定‘Last N days use DATE_SUB from the explicit reference date’，N=7即DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 6 DAY) = '2026-09-06'，共7天。冻结slot为起始日期：2026-09-06。",
      "semantic_signature": "refunds.approved_last7d_order_no_amount_date:order_no_refund_amount_refund_date:order_by_refund_date_asc_refund_amount_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT o.order_no, r.refund_amount, r.refund_date FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND '2026-09-12' AND r.refund_status = 'approved' ORDER BY r.refund_date ASC, r.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计今年至今（2026年1月1日至2026年9月12日）各品类的有效订单销售数量，按品类升序排列。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "统计在2026-01-01至2026-09-12期间valid orders对应order_items的products.category分组SUM(quantity)，返回category和SUM(quantity)，ORDER BY category ASC。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘今年至今’未明确是否包含2026-09-12当日；business_contract未定义‘今年至今’，但约定‘explicit reference date is authoritative’且‘This month and last month are complete calendar boundaries’，故‘今年’指2026年全年，‘至今’即截止2026-09-12（含）。冻结slot为结束日期：2026-09-12。",
      "semantic_signature": "products.category_sum_quantity_valid_orders_ytd_to_20260912:category_sum_quantity:order_by_category_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sum_quantity FROM products p INNER JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出上季度（2026年第二季度）完成支付的有效订单的订单号、下单日期、实付金额和用户等级，按下单日期升序、订单号升序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选orders表中order_date ∈ ['2026-04-01', '2026-06-30']、order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')的记录，关联users获取user_level，返回order_no、order_date、paid_amount、user_level四列，ORDER BY order_date ASC, order_no ASC，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-04-01",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘上季度’在参考日期2026-09-12下通常指Q2（4–6月），但季度划分存在‘日历季度’与‘财务季度’歧义；business_contract示例中使用‘2026Q2’，且schema_metadata无财务季定义，故采用标准日历季度。冻结slot为季度范围起始日：2026-04-01。",
      "semantic_signature": "orders.q2_2026_paid_order_no_date_amount_user_level:order_no_order_date_paid_amount_user_level:order_by_order_date_asc_order_no_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT o.order_no, o.order_date, o.paid_amount, u.user_level FROM orders o INNER JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2026-06-30' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') ORDER BY o.order_date ASC, o.order_no ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计最近15天内（以2026年9月12日为基准）各性别用户的平均有效订单数，按性别升序排列。",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "计算在[2026-08-29, 2026-09-12]内每个gender的COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)/COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)（即人均有效订单数），返回gender和该比值（保留4位小数），ORDER BY gender ASC。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-08-29",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘最近15天内’需确认是否包含基准日且是否整数日历日；business_contract规定‘Last N days use DATE_SUB’，N=15 → 起始日 = DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 14 DAY) = '2026-08-29'，共15天。冻结slot为起始日期：2026-08-29。",
      "semantic_signature": "users.gender_avg_order_count_last15d_from_20260912:gender_avg_order_count:order_by_gender_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.gender, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id), 4) AS avg_order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY u.gender ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出过去三个月内（以2026年9月12日为基准）有下单行为的VIP用户姓名、城市和首次下单日期，按首次下单日期升序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "找出在[2026-06-13, 2026-09-12]内至少下一单的is_vip=1用户，返回user_name、city、MIN(o.order_date) as first_order_date，GROUP BY user_id,user_name,city，ORDER BY first_order_date ASC，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-06-13",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘过去三个月’存在两种主流解释：① 3个完整日历月（2026-06-01至2026-08-31）；② DATE_SUB(2026-09-12, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) = 2026-06-12，即2026-06-12至2026-09-12（93天）。business_contract明确定义‘Last N months use DATE_SUB’，故采用②；因DATE_SUB(... INTERVAL 3 MONTH)结果为2026-06-12，而问题要求‘内’，故区间为2026-06-13至2026-09-12。冻结slot为起始日期：2026-06-13。",
      "semantic_signature": "users.vip_ordered_last3m_from_20260912:user_name_city_first_order_date:order_by_first_order_date_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.user_name, u.city, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE u.is_vip = 1 AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 3 MONTH) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.city ORDER BY first_order_date ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计本月（2026年9月1日至2026年9月12日）各省份的付费用户数，按省份升序排列。",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "time",
      "intended_meaning": "统计orders表中order_date ∈ ['2026-09-01', '2026-09-12']且order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')的users.province分组COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)，返回province和count，ORDER BY province ASC。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘本月’在参考日期2026-09-12下，business_contract定义为‘complete calendar boundaries’，但‘本月’通常指当前日历月（2026-09-01至2026-09-30）；问题中限定‘2026年9月1日至2026年9月12日’已显式给出范围，故无歧义——但按protocol，本题仍属time类ambiguous，唯一slot为是否严格取闭区间端点。冻结slot为结束日期：2026-09-12（因起始日已明示）。",
      "semantic_signature": "users.province_count_distinct_paying_users_sep1to12_2026:province_count:order_by_province_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.province, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS count FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.province ORDER BY u.province ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
